section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used to assess body appreciation (BAS), caregiver eating messages (CEMS), adult attachment (ECRS), perfectionism (APS-R), depressive symptoms (BDI-II), intuitive eating (IES), and body mass index (BMI). The study measured body appreciation using the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale, and BMI was calculated from self-reported weight and height, with a mean BMI of 23.1 (SD = 4.8) for the current sample. No explicit study labels or multiple sample subsets are mentioned in this section.
